offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures hot-mix asphalt plants, combustion systems and aggregate processing equipment, sold to asphalt producers, road contractors and aggregate producers worldwide, mainly built in-house and sold directly or through dealers.

primary_products.value: hot-mix asphalt plants; burner and combustion systems; aggregate processing equipment; replacement parts

primary_services.value: equipment installation; field service; parts supply

items.detail: asphalt producers, road and paving contractors, aggregate producers, mining and construction companies
asphalt plants, combustion systems and aggregate equipment sold to producers and contractors
installation, field service and replacement parts
builds plants and equipment from purchased components, sold to asphalt and aggregate producers

geography_served.detail: Sells equipment to customers in the United States and many other countries

specialization.detail: asphalt plants, combustion systems and aggregate processing equipment serving the same paving and aggregate customers

items.detail: sales engineers selling plants to producers and contractors
independent dealers and sales agents in some markets

regulatory_exposure.detail: Equipment must meet air emissions and safety standards, such as EPA air permitting rules for asphalt plants

notes: Company size and geography are judged from the product range and sales footprint; the exact share of sales by country is not known.
